description: A PostHog managed reverse proxy: a custom subdomain you own that proxies PostHog ingestion. After creation, add a CNAME record from Domain to TargetCname; PostHog then verifies the record and provisions the proxy.

ApiKey.description: PostHog personal API key (phx_...) with the scopes this resource type needs. Pass it with a dynamic reference such as {{resolve:ssm-secure:/posthog/api-key}} when calling SetTypeConfiguration; never put it in plain text.

BaseUrl.description: PostHog API host. Leave unset for PostHog Cloud US (https://us.posthog.com); use https://eu.posthog.com for PostHog Cloud EU, or your instance URL when self-hosting.

OrganizationId.description: ID (UUID) of the PostHog organization that owns the proxy.

Domain.description: The custom domain to proxy through, e.g. e.example.com. Must be a subdomain you control.

RootRedirectUrl.description: HTTPS URL that requests to the proxy domain root redirect to. Must use the same registrable domain as the proxy. Omit to disable the redirect.

TargetCname.description: The CNAME target. Create a DNS CNAME record from Domain to this value.

Status.description: Current provisioning status: waiting (DNS verification pending), issuing (SSL certificate being issued), valid (proxy is live), warning (operational with issues), erroring, deleting or timed_out.

Message.description: Human-readable status message with details about errors or warnings, if any.

RootRedirectSupported.description: Whether this proxy supports a redirect from its root URL.

UpdatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last update.
